run_single_request: run the multi_turn_question function with two questions and print the conversation messages
run_batch_requests: run a batch of multi_turn_question requests with different question pairs and collect all response states
stream_function_output: stream the multi_turn_question function output token by token using state.text_iter
set_default_backend: set the default sgl backend to a local Runtime with meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf
get_state_messages: get the conversation messages from a multi_turn_question run state
